wikipediaSummary.title: Only Built 4 Cuban Linx...
wikipediaSummary.extract: Only Built 4 Cuban Linx... is the debut solo album by the American rapper and Wu-Tang Clan member Raekwon, released on August 1, 1995, by Wu-Tang Records, Loud Records, RCA Records, and Bertelsmann Music Group (BMG). The album was loosely composed to play like a film with Raekwon as the "star", fellow Wu-Tang member Ghostface Killah as the "guest-star", and producer RZA as the "director". It features appearances from most members of the Wu-Tang Clan. The album introduces affiliates Cappadonna and Blue Raspberry, and has a guest appearance from rapper Nas, which marked the first collaboration with a non-Wu-Tang-affiliated artist.
